parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `SecretsResponse` in `Shared/MusicShareKit/Tests/MusicShareKitTests/AuthNetworkClientE2ETests.swift` — has `is_test=true`, which is a restraint marker that dominates any action signal. Per the decision rules, a mixed cluster where one record is a production type (`AppSecrets` in `AppServices`) and the other lives in a test file is the canonical restraint pattern. Lifting `AppSecrets` into shared code to unify it with a test-only `SecretsResponse` type-alias would couple production semantics to test infrastructure, which is the exact coupling the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
